# Supplier Data Access Governance

## Purpose

Ensure supplier access to governed information is justified, limited, reviewable, and removable.

## Requirements

Material supplier access SHOULD identify purpose, data categories, permitted roles, authentication expectations, export or onward-use restrictions, review cadence, and termination conditions.

Supplier access should be reduced or removed when the business purpose changes, the contract ends, or risk no longer supports the access granted.
